verdict.rationale: Proton Pass's official CLI is a programmatic interface that covers a meaningful share of UI functions: vault CRUD, item CRUD across many item types, and managing member access to shared vaults, and it works in headless and CI/CD environments. There is no documented public API, and many UI features have no evidence of programmatic access. missing for 10: a documented public API, programmatic access to hide-my-email aliases, Pass Monitor, passkeys, emergency access, file attachments and import/export, and any explicit UI-parity statement or independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: Create, read, update, and delete vaults
View, create, update, and delete items including passwords, secure notes, credit cards, identities, WiFi entries, custom items, and stored SSH-key items
Manage member access and permissions to shared vaults and items
Work in CI/CD, servers, containers, and headless environments
